KOReader Plugins

Plugins extend KOReader — add downloaders, sync tools, UI tweaks, clocks, dictionaries, and other handy features.

Essential

  • Audiobook Read-Along - TTS with synchronized word highlighting, automatic page turns, Bluetooth audio, audiobook/music playback, and Audiobookshelf server integration. Works offline on Kindle, Kobo, Android, and Linux
  • Time Block - Schedule KOReader reading windows with PIN-locked parental controls
  • Project: Title - Enhanced cover browser with custom title bar, book listings, and visual improvements
  • ZenOS - Interface layer for KOReader with a Home page of widgets, a redesigned Library, a quick Controls panel and a launcher
  • Notes - Handwritten notes with stylus support
  • Crossword - Solve crosswords on your device
  • Anki - Generate Anki flashcards from dictionary lookups
  • Reader Menu Redesign - Redesigned reader menus and popups
  • Digital Clock - Display time, date and image as clock
  • Reading Ruler - Movable underline to guide reading
  • Weight Tracker - Track weight measurements
  • Smart Delete - Enhanced file deletion with warnings
  • Weather - Weather forecasts and conditions
  • MTA Stop - Real-time MTA bus arrivals and local weather
  • Web Browser - Text-based web browsing
  • Assistant (omer-faruq) - AI assistant for translation and summarization while reading
  • Go To Bed - Enforces bedtime
  • ScreenLockPin - Protect your KOReader with a PIN
  • Screenlock (Wake PIN) - Lock KOReader with a PIN after wake
  • Pinpad Screenlock - Numeric keypad PIN lock-screen variant
  • SimpleUI - Highly customizable home screen with bottom navigation
  • Bookshelf - Home screen where you pick a book from your shelf and read it
  • Bookends - Configurable text overlays with tokens, icons, per-line styling and presets

File Management & Sync

  • Telegram Downloader - Send files via Telegram bot
  • ZenFM - Web file manager for your e-reader. Browse, upload and share files from a phone or computer on the same network. Beta
  • LocalSend - Wireless file transfer to Kindle without USB or server setup
  • Annotation Sync - Sync annotations across devices via cloud
  • Super Sync - Full metadata sync to cloud storage
  • Email to KOReader - Receive documents and articles directly to your device via email
  • SyncThing - Seamless file synchronization across devices using Syncthing
  • FileSync - Wireless file manager
  • KOSyncthing+ - Managed Syncthing daemon inside KOReader with Wi-Fi handling and conflict resolution
  • Backup - Device backup and restore
  • Syncery - Cross-device sync of reading progress, annotations, metadata and font/style settings
  • Deluxe Sync - Multi-server capable KOReader Sync client
  • Library Sync - Sync missing books from a Booklore/Grimmory OPDS server
  • OPDS Folder Sync - Per-catalog sync folders and automatic downloads for OPDS
  • Syncthing (Kindle & Kobo) - Run Syncthing on Kindle and Kobo e-readers
  • Kindle MTP - USB file transfer (MTP) on newer Kindles while KOReader keeps running
  • Remote Library - Browse your remote cloud libraries inside KOReader's file manager
  • USBNet Calibre Connect - Connects KOReader to Calibre over USBNet

  • SciELO - Search and download open access articles from SciELO
